correctness.rationale: For Brownian killing at two target-lift boundaries, solve D uʺ=r u, u(0)=u(L)=1; renewal yields exact rate/FPT cosh transform. Strict total positivity of cosh(qt) for distinct nonnegative q,t is proved from nonnegative generalized Vandermonde Cauchy–Binet terms with a positive ordinary Vandermonde term. The signed difference of two at-most-N atomic folded measures has at most 2N nodes; 2N evaluations including normalization at q=0 force every coefficient to vanish. A Chebyshev triangular transform, positive definite Hankel matrix and Prony polynomial reconstruct sites and weights. Invariance of domain proves universal lower bound on fixed scalar probes. Compact moment determinacy proves the whole-response mirror quotient. Symbolic examples with N=2,3,4, 75-digit numeric inversion and kernel determinants were reproduced; finite checks support but do not replace the complete proof.

value.rationale: A physically motivated exact inverse problem with a natural minimal experiment count: the entire unknown support and positive weights of an N-component resetting-site distribution are determined by precisely 2N−1 generic scalar MFPT rate measurements, not a full first-passage distribution. The result is optimal for any positive rate locations, shows explicit reconstruction and identifies complete irreducible mirror information loss; this is a structural identifiability boundary rather than a routine parameter substitution. No statistical stability or noisy inference is claimed.
